candidates.title: Discover known capabilities before factory invention
candidates.problem: Factory work repeatedly lacked a durable, executable search and evidence path for existing reusable work.
candidates.origin: sf0.8 ecosystem compounding decision and issues 31/53

frequency.basis: separate recurrence correction and reuse-discovery increment

candidates.workaround: Agent memory, issue-specific notes, and manual registry searches.
candidates.internal_solution: reuse-registry.json, discover-reuse.py, and changed-path reuse gates.

economic_evidence.note: Avoided internal duplication is not market evidence.

evidence.claim: The factory added a reuse registry and changed-path gate after documented recurrence.
External users pay for this problem.

candidates.next_validation_action: Review independent factory or OSS workflows for the same evidence-discovery burden; do not publish or build a service.
candidates.stop_condition: Stop if the problem remains unique to Foculoom or existing alternatives meet the need without measurable external pain.

candidates.title: Prevent false factory idleness by harvesting bounded work
candidates.problem: Blocked product work was incorrectly treated as factory-wide idleness while safe archaeology, reuse, hygiene, and validation work existed.

frequency.basis: one root-caused incident with dogfood replay

severity.impact: lost bounded work and false waiting state

candidates.workaround: Conversation-level inspection and manual selection of local validators.
candidates.internal_solution: idle_work.py provider manifest, classifier, dispatcher, and exhaustion validator.

economic_evidence.note: No external cost or purchase evidence.

candidates.defensibility: Bounded governance and provider contracts, not a market moat.

evidence.claim: The dispatcher found 11 eligible bounded candidates in dogfood.
Independent factories have the same paid problem.

candidates.next_validation_action: Compare one independent local factory workflow for false-idle behavior before generalizing; no public release.
candidates.stop_condition: Stop if no second internal consumer appears or if provider complexity exceeds saved human attention.

candidates.title: Scale reuse evidence to change size
candidates.problem: Reuse and contribution review was absent or too informal before substantial factory machinery was built.
candidates.workaround: Ad hoc issue notes and retrospective review.
candidates.internal_solution: Proportional reuse gate, candidate records, registry, and tests.

economic_evidence.note: Governance savings are not pricing evidence.

evidence.claim: The root-cause analysis records missing reuse and contribution gates.
Organizations would pay for the gate as a standalone tool.

known: two internal validator consumers for related capability
candidates.next_validation_action: Search independent public workflows for comparable evidence requirements and existing alternatives; record only verified sources.
candidates.stop_condition: Stop at WATCH if external recurrence or economic evidence cannot be found without speculative outreach.

candidates.title: Rendit deterministic rendering and review workflow
candidates.problem: Rendit needs deterministic rendering, provenance, dependency isolation, and review controls across workflows.

frequency.scope: Rendit plus independent Foculoom consumer workflows
frequency.basis: deterministic probe and provenance records in multiple projects

candidates.workaround: Keep one canonical Rendit runtime and expose workflow-level wrappers.
candidates.internal_solution: Rendit tests, provenance, lockfiles, golden fixtures, and proposed bounded skill prototype.

external_evidence.note: Independent public technical sources corroborate the problem category; they do not prove Rendit-specific customer demand.

economic_evidence.note: No paid alternatives or willingness-to-pay evidence recorded in the artifact.

evidence.claim: Rendit has deterministic and provenance controls but broad runtime coupling.
A workflow-level artifact could serve independent consumers.
A clean pinned probe produced identical PNG and sidecar hash outputs across two runs, and multiple Foculoom projects preserve Rendit provenance.
Independent technical sources corroborate deterministic build and provenance problems.
The artifact has external economic value or Rendit-specific customer demand.

candidates.next_validation_action: Stop autonomous research; require a human-authorized external workflow observation or interview before any packaging decision.
candidates.stop_condition: Stop and retain Rendit as internal infrastructure if the wrapper cannot preserve determinism or no second consumer emerges.

candidates.title: Evidence-backed CI status inspection
candidates.problem: A stuck or aborted CI watch was previously mistaken for reliable CI state.
candidates.origin: sf0.8 v0.1 retrospective and CI incident evidence

frequency.basis: retrospective says the script paid for itself twice

candidates.workaround: Use a bounded status script that captures terminal evidence.
candidates.internal_solution: scripts/ci-status.sh and persisted CI result evidence.

economic_evidence.note: Avoided false claims are not pricing evidence.

candidates.defensibility: Evidence contract, not a standalone market advantage.

evidence.claim: The retrospective records ci-status.sh as a retained capability that paid for itself twice internally.
Product A has an independently committed ci-status.sh recurrence guard at commit 6ecb35d, used in its canonical read-only checkout.
External teams would pay for this workflow.

candidates.next_validation_action: Keep as internal infrastructure; compare the two consumers' required contract before considering a generalized internal capability.
candidates.stop_condition: Stop if the evidence remains limited to Foculoom and the maintenance cost exceeds saved verification effort.
